turns.speaker: user
turns.text: This is my first international flight and I'm honestly a bit anxious. When should I get to the airport?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For international flights, about three hours before departure is a safe rule.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Three hours? What do I do for three hours?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Check in, bag drop and security can take a while. Once you're through, you can relax, eat something and find your gate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I check in online first?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, most airlines open it a day before. You'll get your seat and boarding pass on your phone, which saves time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: do I take my shoes off?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It depends on the airport. Just watch the signs and the people ahead of you, the staff will tell you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That helps. I feel a bit less nervous.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You'll be fine. Everyone was a first-timer once.
